shots.description: A matte black bottle stands on a dark stone slab in a black studio, a single warm key light raking across its label from the left; fine dust drifts in the beam
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the label.

shots.description: a top-down view as a slow pour of amber liquid fills a low glass beside the bottle, the surface catching the key light in a moving highlight
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot.

shots.description: a close shot of the bottle with the glass now in soft focus behind it, the label crisp and centered
shots.camera: The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed.

intent.soundscape: Quiet studio room tone, the soft pour of liquid into glass, and a single faint clink as the glass settles.
intent.music: A low sustained synth pad at a slow tempo with a soft pulse every two seconds, fading out at the end.

shots.description: A medium shot frames a woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a grey wool coat at a rain-streaked café window, a folded letter in her hands
shots.camera: The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed.

dialogue.speaker: the woman
dialogue.text: I get off at the next station.

shots.description: a close-up of a man in his forties with a trimmed beard across the table, his coffee untouched, looking up from the cup
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot.

dialogue.speaker: the man
dialogue.text: Then I'll wait on the platform.

intent.soundscape: Steady rain taps against the window under low café room tone; cups clink softly in the background and a chair scrapes once.
intent.music: Sparse piano notes at a slow tempo, joined by a sustained low string that fades out under the last line.

intent.style: Live-action, handheld smartphone footage in vertical framing

shots.description: A young man with curly hair and a green hoodie holds a steaming bowl of ramen up to the phone in a small kitchen, the bowl filling the lower half of the frame
shots.camera: The camera shakes slightly as he adjusts the phone.

shots.description: he lifts noodles with chopsticks, blows on them, tastes, and his eyes widen as he nods at the phone
shots.camera: The camera holds close on his face.

intent.soundscape: Kitchen room tone with a refrigerator hum, chopsticks tapping the bowl, a slurp, and a short laugh.

intent.style: Claymation, stop-motion with visible fingerprints in the clay

shots.description: A wide shot of a grey-blue clay sea under a clay storm sky; a clay whale rises from the water, arcs, and crashes back, sending clay droplets outward
shots.camera: The camera tilts up with large amplitude at fast speed to follow the breach, then settles.

intent.soundscape: Wind across water, a deep whoosh as the whale rises, and a heavy splash with scattered droplets landing.
intent.music: Plucked strings at a brisk tempo with a timpani hit on the splash.

shots.description: A medium shot inside a glass greenhouse: a girl with a straw hat and a white dress pours tea into a porcelain cup at a wooden table, sunlight through the panes making bright patches on the floor
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

shots.description: a close-up of the cup as the tea swirls, steam rising, a leaf drifting down into the frame and landing on the saucer
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot.

intent.soundscape: Tea pouring into porcelain, birdsong outside the glass, and the creak of the wooden table as she leans in.
intent.music: A gentle music-box melody at a slow tempo with a soft harp arpeggio underneath.

shots.description: A low-angle tracking shot follows a model in a long red coat and black boots walking down a wet city street at night, neon reflections sliding across the pavement
shots.camera: The camera tracks the subject with large amplitude at normal speed, staying at knee height.

intent.soundscape: Boot heels striking wet pavement, distant traffic, and the hum of neon signs.
intent.music: A driving electronic beat at a fast tempo with a deep bass line that drops out for the last second.

presets.title: First and last frame: a turn to camera

shots.description: The subject begins in the position and framing of Picture 1, turns toward the camera through a natural weight shift, and settles into the pose, spacing and composition of Picture 2
shots.camera: The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed.

intent.soundscape: Room tone with the rustle of clothing as the subject turns.

intent.style: 3D CG animation with a dark background and one accent colour

shots.description: A wide shot of a slowly rotating chrome ring above a black reflective floor, a band of teal light travelling around its edge; the last frame matches the first so the clip loops without a cut
shots.camera: The camera performs an arc shot with small amplitude at slow speed.

intent.soundscape: A faint electrical hum that stays level for the whole loop.
